papers.abstract: Constrained preference-conditioned MORL typically assumes full task observability, treating preferences and safety budgets as stationary task signals. In real-world deployment, however, these signals are often unreliable proxies: intent may drift, safety tolerances may shift with context, and exposed descriptors may be noisy, delayed, or incomplete. We therefore formulate constrained preference-conditioned MORL as a partially observed task-specification problem, where the agent must navigate a fundamental conflict between unreliable external signals and latent interaction dynamics. We propose \textbf{BECON}, a belief-conditioned framework for constrained MORL with drifting preferences and budgets, which infers latent task context from recent histories to estimate preferences and safety budgets. These estimates are fused with the exposed task signal via uncertainty-dependent gates, enabling the policy to defer to observations under high epistemic uncertainty while correcting them when history is informative. The fused context jointly conditions preference optimization and context-adaptive constraint enforcement. Experiments on diverse multi-objective control tasks demonstrate that BECON consistently improves over state-of-the-art MORL baselines, achieving stronger robustness and constraint satisfaction under task drift.

summary.takeaway: 将约束偏好条件多目标强化学习形式化为部分可观测任务规格问题，并提出信念条件框架 BECON 以应对偏好与预算漂移。
summary.methods: 从近期历史推断潜在任务上下文以估计偏好与安全预算，通过不确定性依赖的门控与暴露任务信号融合，联合条件化偏好优化和上下文自适应约束执行；在多种多目标控制任务上实验。
summary.relevance: 属于强化学习主题，针对偏好与安全预算不可靠或漂移下的约束多目标决策问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅称在多样多目标控制任务上优于 SOTA 基线，未给出具体任务集、数值或漂移设置细节。

papers.title: Anchor Behavior, Not Parameters: Rehearsal-Free Continual Learning with a Single Shared Prompt
papers.abstract: Prompt-based continual learning adapts a frozen pre-trained vision transformer by tuning a small set of prompt tokens. Recently, one-prompt methods which share one single prompt across all tasks make this paradigm maximally parameter efficient. The open question is how a shared prompt can keep the knowledge of old classes while being updated for new ones. Existing methods protect old knowledge in parameter space, where they freeze task-specific prompts, expand new components, or sparsely gate which tokens receive gradients. However, this method sacrifices plasticity, yet the drift it still permits in shared tokens can corrupt the prompt's function on past classes. What must be preserved is the prompt's behavior. We propose TEA-Prompt, which couples (i) a token evaluation module that assigns each prompt token a continuous, input-conditional relevance score injected into the attention logits, softly specializing tokens across tasks without discarding any of them, and (ii) an attention-behavior anchoring loss that constrains each token's attention output around class-specific query regions using only compact Gaussian query statistics without stored old images, weighted by the token's past relevance. Anchoring the attention value allows the parameters to continue updating freely, as long as their interaction remains unchanged. TEA-Prompt achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with markedly lower forgetting on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-R, and CUB-200 with only 0.38M parameters. Code is publicy available at https://github.com/cuonga1cvp/TEA-Prompt.git

summary.takeaway: 提出 TEA-Prompt，主张在基于提示的持续学习中锚定提示的行为而非参数，以单个共享提示实现无回放持续学习。
summary.methods: 冻结预训练视觉 Transformer，仅调共享提示；用 token 评估模块为每个提示 token 赋予输入条件连续相关性分数并注入注意力 logits，并用注意力行为锚定损失以紧凑高斯查询统计约束 token 注意力输出；在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet-R、CUB-200 上评估，仅 0.38M 参数。
summary.relevance: 属于持续学习主题，关注参数高效、无回放的提示式持续学习方法。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告了准确率与更低遗忘，但未给出具体数值或与各基线的逐项对比细节。

papers.title: Plate design confounds donor variation and model evaluation in single-cell perturbation screens
papers.abstract: Single-cell screens of immune cells from many donors are used to study why individuals respond differently and to benchmark response models. Each donor-perturbation combination typically occupies one well, controls are grouped, and donors share one layout, so technical effects can look biological. Using a 90-cytokine screen, two compound screens, four cohorts and simulations, we show that well effects explain most replicate-control variation in abundant cell types, controls carry a shared offset, and identical control wells differ by hundreds of differentially expressed genes at a standard threshold, about as many as two receptor-negative proteins do. Negative controls, design-aware estimators and perturbation-specific evaluation change the interpretation of four recent analyses. A deep-learning model that scores below a perturbation-agnostic predictor under standard evaluation outperforms a simple baseline on perturbation-specific differences in two of three cell types (significantly in one with stricter controls), but predicts less well the component shared with inert wells.

summary.takeaway: 研究表明单细胞扰动筛选中孔板设计混杂供体变异与模型评估，技术性孔效应可被误读为生物学差异。
summary.methods: 使用 90 细胞因子筛选、两个化合物筛选、四个队列和模拟，分析孔效应、对照偏移及相同对照孔间差异表达基因数；比较设计感知估计器与扰动特异性评估对近期分析解释的影响，并评估深度学习模型与简单基线。
summary.relevance: 属于单细胞扰动主题，直接讨论扰动筛选的实验设计与模型基准评估偏差。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供各筛选的具体样本量、效应大小或模型性能的完整数值；结论基于所分析的四个队列与模拟，外推需谨慎。

papers.title: Multicellular Perturb-seq Reveals Lineage-Specific Transcriptional Control During Human Cardiac Organoid Development
papers.abstract: Heart development requires the coordinated differentiation of multiple cell lineages, including cardiomyocytes (CMs) and endothelial cells (ECs). Transcription factors (TFs) orchestrate lineage specification, morphogenesis, and maturation, yet how cardiac and vascular TFs shape multicellular organization and their interactions remain poorly understood. Many TFs exhibit pleiotropic and stage-dependent effects across cardiac lineages, particularly in cardiac progenitor cells, suggesting the presence of shared regulatory networks that synchronize cardiac and vascular programs during development and in response to stress. Human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC) differentiated cardiac organoid provides a physiologically relevant 3D model to study these multicellular interactions, enabling simultaneous differentiation of ECs and CMs within a human genetic context. When combined with CRISPR interference (CRISPRi) based Perturb-seq, this system allows systematic, high-throughput dissection of TF-driven regulatory programs at single-cell resolution. In this study, we investigated how cardiac and vascular TFs coordinate lineage commitment and the cross-lineage signaling in human cardiovascular differentiation.

summary.takeaway: 利用多细胞 Perturb-seq 在人心脏类器官发育中解析心肌与内皮谱系特异的转录调控。
summary.methods: 以 hiPSC 分化的心脏类器官为 3D 多细胞模型，结合 CRISPRi 基础 Perturb-seq 在单细胞分辨率高通量剖析心脏与血管转录因子驱动的调控程序及跨谱系信号。
summary.relevance: 属于单细胞扰动主题，将 Perturb-seq 应用于人多细胞心脏类器官的谱系承诺与跨谱系信号研究。
summary.caveat: 摘要为研究背景与目标描述，未给出扰动规模、具体转录因子或主要发现结果。

papers.title: ReGKG-2025: A GKG-Compatible Reconstruction of the GDELT Global Knowledge Graph for the Missing Period of 14 June to 2 July 2025
papers.abstract: The June 2025 outage in the Global Database of Events, Language, and Tone (GDELT) collection pipeline left a gap in the Global Knowledge Graph (GKG), interrupting article-level news metadata used in downstream research. ReGKG-2025 is an archive-derived sample of 281,620 reconstructed article records covering all 1,665 missing 15-minute batches. Articles were recovered from Common Crawl and the Wayback Machine using source quotas estimated from surrounding native GKG data. Text was screened and normalized, non-English bodies were translated, and flagged records were manually reviewed. Eligible articles were converted to the 27-column GKG 2.1 layout. The versioned package includes record-level provenance, archive replay and WARC locators, source summaries, source-by-day calibration weights, and the complete manual decision journal. The sample reaches about 14% of modeled native volume and represents sources accounting for 84% of selected reference record mass. In an intact-week test, 41% of recovered articles matched native GKG records; field agreement on matched pairs is close to the processor baseline (tone MAE 1.69). The dataset supports retrospective content analysis and source-level aggregates; its tone and theme distributions differ from native GKG, and it does not support exhaustive counts. Data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23964265.

summary.takeaway: 发布 ReGKG-2025，以档案来源重建 GDELT 全球知识图谱在 2025 年 6 月 14 日至 7 月 2 日缺失期的样本。
summary.methods: 从 Common Crawl 与 Wayback Machine 按周边原生 GKG 数据估计的来源配额恢复 281,620 条文章记录，覆盖全部 1,665 个缺失 15 分钟批次；经文本筛选归一化、非英文翻译与人工复核，转换为 27 列 GKG 2.1 布局，并附来源溯源、校准权重与决策日志。
summary.relevance: 属于知识图谱主题，提供 GDELT GKG 缺失时段的可追溯重建数据。
summary.caveat: 样本仅约建模原生量的 14%，语气与主题分布不同于原生 GKG，不支持穷尽计数；完整周测试中 41% 恢复文章与原生记录匹配。

papers.title: Swallowing-Induced Ventricular Tachycardia: Mechanistic Inference and Patient Management Require Caution.

summary.takeaway: 标题提示吞咽诱发室性心动过速的机制推断与患者管理需谨慎，但摘要为空，无法从文本确认具体贡献。
summary.methods: 摘要未提供，无法概括研究方法与数据。
summary.relevance: 匹配主题为机制推理，但缺少摘要内容，相关性只能从标题推断。
summary.caveat: 摘要为空，所有实质结论均不可从摘要验证。

papers.title: STABLE: A Continual Learning Optimizer with Adaptive Drift Control
papers.abstract: Continual learning suffers from catastrophic forgetting, leading to the loss of past knowledge and unstable adaptation across task streams. Existing approaches typically address this issue through replay buffers, architectural changes, or additional regularization terms. We argue that forgetting is a consequence of unstable learning dynamics, which may benefit from an optimizer-level solution. The main challenge is that learning dynamics are time-dependent, as demonstrated by empirical phenomena such as the stability gap. First, we formally prove that, for distance-based classifiers, bounded parameter drift guarantees bounded margin erosion under a local score-stability condition. Based on this insight, we propose STABLE, a primal-dual optimizer with adaptive drift control. STABLE enforces a drift budget by increasing the dual variable when the budget is violated and decreasing it otherwise. This results in high stability without penalizing plasticity. Experiments on long-horizon unimodal streams and CLIP-based multimodal streams show that vanilla PEFT baselines trained with STABLE match or outperform specialized continual learning methods. In the multimodal setting, STABLE further preserves zero-shot transfer, matching or exceeding dedicated multimodal continual learning methods.

summary.takeaway: 提出优化器层面的持续学习方案 STABLE，通过自适应漂移控制在不牺牲可塑性的前提下提升稳定性。
summary.methods: 形式证明距离分类器在有界参数漂移与局部分数稳定条件下可保证有界边际侵蚀；据此设计原始-对偶优化器，以漂移预算约束并通过增降对偶变量自适应调节；在长时程单模态流与基于 CLIP 的多模态流上实验。
summary.relevance: 属于持续学习主题，从优化器角度应对灾难性遗忘与稳定性差距。
summary.caveat: 理论保证限于距离分类器与局部分数稳定条件；摘要称匹配或超越专门方法，但未给出具体数值与任务规模。

papers.title: SCorPion: A Strategic, Controllable and Personified Conversational Companion
papers.abstract: Fixed prompt-based language models face challenges in open-domain conversations, where versatile topics require different expert advice or demonstrations to maximize their universal performance. Motivated by the dynamic prompt studies in language generation, we extract different chatting strategies from varied forms of text corpus, which steer the language model to different styles based on human principles. We design and deploy a conversational companion called SCorPion, which uses GraphRAG to extract and summarize the knowledge graph globally, yield community-summarized strategies, and produce query-focused optimal strategies. SCorPion has strategic thinking, yields personified and stylized responses, and can be controlled by explicit factors. Code and further results can be found in https://bachozean.github.io/scorpion-page/.

summary.takeaway: 提出并部署对话伴侣 SCorPion，利用 GraphRAG 提取与总结知识图谱以生成可控制、个性化的策略性回复。
summary.methods: 从多样文本语料提取不同聊天策略，使用 GraphRAG 全局提取与总结知识图谱、生成社区总结策略并产出查询聚焦的最优策略，以显式因素控制语言模型风格。
summary.relevance: 属于检索增强与对齐及知识图谱主题，将 GraphRAG 用于开放域对话的策略化与人格化控制。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告定量评估、用户研究或与基线的比较结果。

papers.title: Agentic AI enables cell segmentation-free cell-type inference and cell-type-guided cell segmentation in spatial transcriptomics
papers.abstract: Cell-type identification in spatial transcriptomics often relies on cell segmentation, which can introduce inaccuracies in cell boundaries and transcript assignment. Segmentation-free or cell-free methods have been developed to completely avoid cell segmentation, but inaccurate cell typing hinder accurate downstream analysis. Here, we introduce SSAF-T, a segmentation-free agentic framework that identifies cell types directly from spatial gene expression without predefined reference datasets. For the reference-free cell typing, SSAF-T incorporates CeLLMan, which employs expert-level agents for each organ to annotate cell types using a literature-grounded knowledge graph. We benchmark SSAF-T on both array-based and imaging-based spatial transcriptomics datasets in terms of accuracy, reproducibility, and scalability. We further show that SSAF-T provides an accurate cell segmentation based on the segmentation-free mapping, which ensure compatibility to existing downstream analysis ecosystem, and eventually enable quantitative analysis at single-cell level.

summary.takeaway: 提出无分割的 agentic 框架 SSAF-T，可直接从空间基因表达推断细胞类型，并可基于无分割映射实现细胞类型引导的细胞分割。
summary.methods: SSAF-T 无需预定义参考数据集；其 CeLLMan 组件为各器官配置专家级 agent，利用文献支撑的知识图谱注释细胞类型；在基于微阵列和基于成像的空间转录组数据集上评估准确性、可重复性和可扩展性。
summary.relevance: 该工作以文献知识图谱驱动专家 agent 进行无参考细胞类型注释，与知识图谱主题直接相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅提及在两类空间转录组数据集上的基准评估，未给出具体性能数值或与其他方法的定量比较；知识图谱覆盖范围及器官外推能力未说明。
